description: Na₃MoO₃F₃ is Ilmenite-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to three equivalent O and three equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent MoO₃F₃ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra, and  a faceface with one MoO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.33 Å. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.32 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to three equivalent O and three equivalent F atoms to form NaO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₃F₃ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-39°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.41 Å. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.23 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to three equivalent O and three equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent MoO₃F₃ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 72°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.45 Å. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.25 Å. Mo is bonded to three equivalent O and three equivalent F atoms to form distorted MoO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one NaO₃F₃ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-39°. All Mo-O bond lengths are 1.75 Å. All Mo-F bond lengths are 2.12 Å. O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. F is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Mo trigonal pyramids.
